src: isolated control pixels s in the single row or column, ordered left-to-right or top-to-bottom
dst: expanded sprite-copy slots d along the same axis, with the template-color slot fixed at the original red sprite bbox
match_cond: rank(s) == rank(d); empty gaps between adjacent controls become gaps between adjacent sprite bboxes
transform: stamp the 8-connected red sprite mask into each slot recolored to s.color; keep control pixels and the original template unchanged
symbol_instructions: the control-pixel line gives the copy colors, read direction, and inter-copy gaps
